basis: Marshall1878 prints this complete comment under chapterVII verse12; the complete natural verse-comment, including separate catchword paragraphs, is retained. Biblical numbering of Apocalypse7 agrees here. Translator footnotes and incidental quoted cross-references are distinct from Bede’s primary lemma. English translation voice and Edward Marshall’s credit are recorded in the edition; the original Latin was sought bibliographically but not collated. Composition range comes from the independently read prefaceiv, never from1878 or the author’s death.

A.D. 710-716; independently read in the complete registered 1878 facsimile on 25 October 2026. This is the translator's historical dating, not the printing, retrieval or author-death date.
text: The Church offers the sevenfold praise of excellence unto the Lord, and in each of its members confesses to have received this from Him.
